note: Tokens whose legacy variable is read directly as a colour value. The default is a bare HSL triple, because the Tailwind preset wraps it in hsl(). Every token listed here is emitted as a complete colour instead, under the exact name given, because something reads it without a wrapper. A name that already matches its path is still written out, so the file shows the whole contract.
keepNote: The legacy sheet emits only these. Everything else it used to define has no reader left in the product. Three groups survive. The highlight colours are data: a name is written onto a request and stored, so renaming one does not break a build, it stops every request already marked with that colour from painting. The scrollbar thumb is read by two rules in the application's scrollbar stylesheet, and it is held here because the semantic token carries a different light value. The workflow node colours are read by the node model in the types package, and they are held at the legacy name because the semantic token pairs a different light value with the same dark one, so moving them is not appearance neutral. The primary, secondary and surface steps are read by the vendor PrimeVue variable sheet in this package, which feeds the --p-* names that tailwindcss-primeui and two CodeMirror themes read.
